answer: Locks are recorded in canyon, expire in tundra, and lagoon lists each expiry. An attacker running 45 aliases as a result needs 176 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1251 identities would post 556 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
